verses.text: Whosoever is born of God doth not continue in sin; for the Spirit of God remaineth in him; and he cannot continue in sin, because he is born of God, having received that holy Spirit of promise.

title: JST, 1 John 3:9. Compare 1 John 3:9 Whoever is born of God does not continue in sin.
